# pbs_timezone (Resource)

Manages the time zone of a Proxmox Backup Server node, which its job schedules, task logs and web interface go by. The `pbs_time` data source reads the node's current time.

The node is a singleton: creating the resource sets the zone the node has. A node always has a zone, so **destroying the resource leaves it as it is**.

PBS sets the zone with `timedatectl` from PBS 4.2.3 and by linking `/etc/localtime` to the zone's file otherwise. Changing it needs `Sys.Modify on /system/time`; anyone signed in may read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pbs_timezone" "this" {
  timezone = "Europe/Vienna"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `timezone` (String) Time zone, as named in the tz database: `UTC`, `Etc/UTC`, `Europe/Vienna`, `America/New_York`. The node must have its file under `/usr/share/zoneinfo`; PBS 4's Debian installs no legacy names, such as `US/Eastern` or `Europe/Kiev`, unless `tzdata-legacy` is installed. PBS keeps the name as given, so `UTC` and `Etc/UTC` are different values.

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node whose time zone to manage: `localhost`, which every PBS answers to, or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`. PBS is a single node, so both name the same settings: manage them with one resource only. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `node`, present because Terraform requires an `id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_timezone.this
  identity = {
    node = "localhost"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `node` (String) Node name, such as `localhost`.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_timezone.this
  id = "localhost"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The time zone of a node is imported by the node's name.
terraform import pbs_timezone.this localhost
```
